hypothesis: An AR (lag 0-3 by BIC, no drift, last 120 months) on the monthly change in the policy rate forecasts the rate with a lower RMSE than no change, 3 and 12 months ahead.
knownLimits: BIS monthly end-of-month rates; a shared area (the euro area) counts once.
Rates move in steps at meetings; no change is a strong benchmark.
Values are today's vintage (later revisions included); no real-time data vintages are free for all countries, so this is a pseudo real-time test.
